<div class="card-body">
'''I Thought They Smelled Bad On The Outside''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">臭いのは外側だけじゃなかったのか</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の乗用生物を一匹犠牲にする（ロストする）。同じ位置にいるキャラクターを１人選ぶ。キャラクターはこのターンの間、「凍死」、「雪嵐」、「凍傷」、「砂岩嵐」の影響を受けない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-I-Thought-They-Smelled-Bad-On-The-Outside-PSA-157878138.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「我慢しろよ、ルーク。臭いかもしれんが……シェルターをたてるまで……この中ならあったまる」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' So it didn't smell bad only on the outside.

'''Card text:'''
Sacrifice (lose) one of your creature vehicles. Choose one character at the same location. That character is immune to Exposure, Ice Storm, Frostbite and Gravel Storm this turn.

'''Lore:'''
"Hang on, Luke. It may smell, but… until I get a shelter up… you'll stay warm in here."

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese immunizes one character and has no Ronto extra or Tzizvvt power option.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[I Thought They Smelled Bad On The Outside]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
